title: Document the bounded publication contention wait and unknown-commit handling
outcome: The mailbox-reference feature brief explains publication's original60s budget and non-aborting10s warning, custody release and revalidation, and exact-marker-only handling of unknown commits.
acceptance: docs/features/federation-mailbox-references.md explains that retryable contention uses one original60s budget with one non-aborting10s warning and returns the existing503 on expiry.
